engineering_rules: RULE-NOTION-001: Notion public pages are CSR-walled for unauthenticated agents — content must come from user summary (meta-fallback) or official API with token; do NOT claim direct fetch success
RULE-NOTION-002: protocol-table assets (11-col schema) compile to YAML governance specs with trigger/action/ethics/frequency fields; verify with yaml.safe_load + required-field check
RULE-NOTION-003: memory scaffold generators must have dry-run mode (no writes) + verify() that counts EVERY generated file (including manifest.json — easy to miscount)
boundaries: Notion content is user-summary (browser), not raw page markdown; cell-level detail limited
MMCE toolkit (A3) deferred to P1 — dialogue-to-agent mapping needs design
Scaffold targets governance/memory_demo/ for demo; real .aionui/ adoption needs user decision
